result.topic_en: An archival cover slip recording that one note-sheet in the Gauss papers comes from G. B. Nr. and relates to Lobachevsky's work on applying imaginary geometry to certain integrals; a second reference to Lobachevsky's 'Geometrische Untersuchungen zur Theorie der Parallellinien' is struck out.
